description: Μητρώο Παρόχων Δικτύων και Υπηρεσιών Ηλεκτρονικών Επικοινωνιών is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by EETT. List of Electronic Communications Companies operating under a General Authorization regime. It displays the details of companies providing electronic communications networks and services. Coverage: EETT. The portal shows the English title as "Registry of Electronic Communications and Network Providers" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is EETT. Its keywords include Ηλεκτρονικές επικοινωνίες, repository.data.gov.gr, Τεχνολογία, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-09-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
